name: tubemuse
description: TubeMuse — 按意图找片的个人浏览器扩展（Chrome 与 Firefox，MV3，本地优先）

scripts.e2e: node scripts/build.mjs --e2e && node tests/e2e/run-e2e.mjs && node scripts/build.mjs && node tests/e2e/smoke-prod.mjs
scripts.e2e:firefox: node scripts/build.mjs --firefox --e2e && node tests/e2e/firefox/run.mjs && node scripts/build.mjs --firefox && node tests/e2e/firefox/smoke-xpi.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run e2e && npm run e2e:firefox && npm run package
